# Prompt caching — concept pack

> Prompt caching lets the API reuse an already-processed prompt prefix (tools → system → messages) across requests to cut cost and latency: Anthropic offers automatic caching or explicit `cache_control: {"type": "ephemeral"}` breakpoints with 5-minute or 1-hour TTLs, bills cache writes at 1.25×/2× and cache hits at 0.1× the base input price, and reports them in usage.cache_creation_input_tokens / cache_read_input_tokens; OpenRouter passes cache_control through to Anthropic and Gemini, adds provider sticky routing, and documents OpenAI automatic caching. Two of the three docsets contributed (the OpenAI export is empty).

## Related concepts

- [cache_control](llms-vocabulary.txt): part of Prompt caching — 45 units across 2 sources; Anthropic/OpenRouter per-block cache marker
- [cache breakpoint](llms-vocabulary.txt): part of Prompt caching — 27 units across 2 sources
- [cache hit](llms-vocabulary.txt): measure of Prompt caching — 26 units across 2 sources
- [cache pricing](llms-vocabulary.txt): measure of Prompt caching — 24 units across 2 sources; pricing multipliers and table columns; MTok alone is any price table
- [Message Batches](llms-vocabulary.txt): related of Prompt caching — 21 units across 2 sources; features whose interaction with the prompt cache the docs describe; never qualifies a unit alone
- [prefix hierarchy](llms-vocabulary.txt): part of Prompt caching — 21 units across 1 source; tools → system → messages; a change at one level invalidates it and everything after
- [cache write](llms-vocabulary.txt): measure of Prompt caching — 20 units across 2 sources
- [cache diagnostics](llms-vocabulary.txt): part of Prompt caching — 16 units across 1 source; Anthropic beta that reports why a cache missed
- [automatic caching](llms-vocabulary.txt): hyponym of Prompt caching — 13 units across 2 sources; provider places the cache point (Anthropic auto mode, OpenAI, Gemini implicit)
- [cache TTL](llms-vocabulary.txt): measure of Prompt caching — 13 units across 2 sources
- [cache invalidation](llms-vocabulary.txt): problem of Prompt caching — 11 units across 1 source; what changes cause the prefix to stop matching
- [cache prefix](llms-vocabulary.txt): part of Prompt caching — 10 units across 2 sources; the cache key is the exact request prefix: tools → system → messages
- [cache_read_input_tokens](llms-vocabulary.txt): measure of Prompt caching — 10 units across 2 sources; usage/pricing fields reported per response
- [cacheable](llms-vocabulary.txt): variant of Prompt caching — 7 units across 2 sources; the docs' adjective for content the prompt cache can hold
- [explicit caching](llms-vocabulary.txt): hyponym of Prompt caching — 6 units across 2 sources; caller places cache_control breakpoints
- [cache read](llms-vocabulary.txt): measure of Prompt caching — 6 units across 2 sources
- [cache pre-warming](llms-vocabulary.txt): dependent of Prompt caching — 6 units across 1 source; loading the cache before real traffic
- [sticky routing](llms-vocabulary.txt): dependent of Prompt caching — 5 units across 1 source; OpenRouter: routing follow-up requests to the provider holding the cache
- [ephemeral cache_control type](llms-vocabulary.txt): instance of Prompt caching — 4 units across 1 source; the only cache_control type; bare 'ephemeral' excluded (containers)
- [minimum cacheable prompt length](llms-vocabulary.txt): measure of Prompt caching — 3 units across 2 sources; per-model token floors below which nothing is cached
- [cache-aware rate limits](llms-vocabulary.txt): dependent of Prompt caching — 2 units across 1 source; Anthropic: cache reads excluded from input-tokens-per-minute
- [cache storage and sharing](llms-vocabulary.txt): part of Prompt caching — 2 units across 2 sources; who can hit whose cache
- [KV cache](llms-vocabulary.txt): near-synonym of Prompt caching — 2 units across 2 sources; model-internal attention state; prompt caching is the API feature built on it
